svg.text: Builder - PyExecutor Runtime - MoE Wide-EP - Prefill/Decode Disaggregation
Tokenizer - chat template - LoRA - disagg ctx/gen worker binding
Overlap Scheduler - CUDA Graph - chunked prefill
Continuous batching - streaming - EPLB slot remap hooks (Wide-EP)
TRT plugins: Attention - MoE GEMM - AllReduce - DeepEP / WIDEEP comm kernels
Separate ctx (prefill) and gen (decode) engines optional under disagg
Build once - deploy to ctx pool / gen pool / unified pool

g.text: Ctx and Gen pools may use different TP/EP/PP configs

svg.text: Expert weights sharded - all GPUs see all tokens
Full expert/GPU - only routed tokens arrive
Subset of experts per GPU + TP shard within expert
Comm: DeepEP (prefill/high-B) vs WIDEEP (decode/low-lat, GPU-side dyn size, CUDA Graph) - NVLink/IB across NVL72
Decouple context (prefill) and generation (decode) onto separate GPU pools
Benefit: removes prefill/decode interference - independent perf tuning - long ISL + moderate OSL workloads gain most
Cost: KV block transfer overhead - mitigated by overlapping xfer with other requests + parallel ctx/gen xfers
A100 - H100/H200 - B200 - GH200/GB200 - NVL72 (130 TB/s NVLink) - Tensor Cores FP8/FP4
Unified path: Client - LLM API - PyExecutor - Scheduler - ModelEngine - Sampler - tokens
Disagg path: Client - Dynamo Router - CTX prefill (+KV) - KV xfer - GEN decode loop - tokens | MoE path: Router - dispatch - expert - combine (EPLB remaps slots)
Sources: TensorRT-LLM parallel-strategy, blog04 Wide-EP, blog05 Disaggregated Serving, NVIDIA Dynamo blog
